title: Collective eXplainable AI: Explaining Cooperative Strategies and Agent Contribution in Multiagent Reinforcement Learning with Shapley Values
reasoning: The paper focuses on explainable AI (XAI) within multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). While it discusses 'responsible AI' and evaluates agents in 'Sequential Social Dilemmas' environments, its primary goal is to validate the use of Shapley values for measuring agent contribution rather than evaluating religious or ethical frameworks.
